_meta.description: HelpArticle: one page of shillinq's user guide, seeded from docs/user-guide by the SeedHelpArticles repair step, so the in-app assistant can ground how-to answers in it (REQ-PHA-001). Readable by every user; written by the seed.

HelpArticle.title: Help Article
HelpArticle.description: One page of shillinq's user guide, held as an object so the in-app assistant can search it. Seeded from docs/user-guide on install and upgrade, keyed by sourcePath; an unchanged file (same sourceHash) is left untouched.

slug.description: The page's route in the user guide, with slashes as dashes (e.g. user-guide-bookkeeping-year-end).
slug.title: Slug

title.description: The page title: its front matter title, else its first heading.
title.title: Title

body.description: The page's markdown without its front matter.
body.title: Body

documentationUrl.description: Where the page is published on the documentation site; the assistant links to it.
documentationUrl.title: Documentation URL

pageIds.description: Ids of the app pages whose documentation link points at this article; the assistant prefers articles for the page the user is on.
pageIds.title: Page IDs

language.description: The page's language: its front matter language, else the documentation site's default (en).
language.title: Language

sourcePath.description: The markdown file in the app the article is seeded from, relative to the app root.
sourcePath.title: Source path

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 of the markdown file when it was last seeded; an unchanged hash skips the file.
sourceHash.title: Source hash

search.description: Search shillinq's user guide (help articles). Use for how-to questions about shillinq; filter on pageIds with the page the user is on to prefer the article that explains it.

get.description: Get one help article by id, with its markdown body and documentation link.
